// Vendored snapshot. Do not edit — re-export instead.

{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.50

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Returns object's model info. Model path is suitable for use with [[createSimpleObject]] command.

|s1= [[getModelInfo]] object

|p1= object: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Array]] - array in format [modelName, modelPath, hasSkeleton, placingPoint, mass]
* modelName: [[String]] - For example "car.p3d"
* modelPath: [[String]] - Full path to model. For example: "a3\data\models\car.p3d"
* hasSkeleton: [[Boolean]] - Returns whether the model has a skeleton (which usually means it's also animated)
* {{GVI|arma3|2.08}} placingPoint: [[Vector3D]] - Placing point of the model in model coordinates. Placing point is always in format [0,0,z].
* {{GVI|arma3|2.18}} mass: [[Number]] - Mass defined in the p3d model

|x1= <sqf>_modelInfo = getModelInfo player; // ["b_soldier_03.p3d", "a3\characters_f\blufor\b_soldier_03.p3d", true, [0,0,0]]</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>_modelInfo = getModelInfo cursorObject;</sqf>

|x3= Get Z ASL using placing point:
<sqf>_zASL = (heli modelToWorldWorld (getModelInfo heli select 3)) select 2;</sqf>

|seealso= [[cursorObject]] [[cursorTarget]] [[createSimpleObject]] [[getObjectType]] [[getObjectTextures]] [[objectParent]] [[setVelocityTransformation]] [[getUnitFreefallInfo]] [[getEntityInfo]] [[getMass]]
}}
